name_full: 科萨拉·米蒂奇 Kosara Mitic
introduction: Born in Skopje, in what is now North Macedonia, in 1987, the director and screenwriter has made several short films that have screened at festivals around the world. Her work has gained international recognition for its precise storytelling, emotional restraint and focus on social realities. She is a Berlinale Talents alumna. 17 is her debut feature film.
